exercises.title: Present Continuous — Recupera
exercises.description: Ricostruisci uso, struttura be + -ing, domande, negative e spelling prima della pratica.
exercises.instructions: Capisci la struttura completa: il verbo in -ing da solo non basta.

sections.title: Costruisci il tempo completo
sections.instructions: Osserva prima il significato, poi controlla be e la forma in -ing.

questions.title: Present Continuous: be + verbo in -ing
questions.prompt: Prima di esercitarti
questions.instructions: Leggi le regole e osserva come cambia be.
questions.learning_objective: Use the present continuous for actions happening now or temporary situations with correct be + -ing structure, questions, negatives and basic spelling.

content.body: Il Present Continuous usa am/is/are + verbo in -ing. Serve soprattutto per azioni in corso e situazioni temporanee. Nelle domande be va prima del soggetto; nelle negative aggiungi not a be.
content.intro: L'errore più importante da evitare è usare solo il verbo in -ing: in inglese serve sempre anche am, is o are.

sections.title: Un'azione in corso
sections.body: Usa il Present Continuous quando descrivi qualcosa che sta succedendo adesso o intorno al momento in cui parli.

sections.title: Anche per una situazione temporanea
sections.body: L'azione non deve avvenire in questo preciso secondo: può essere una situazione temporanea che dura per un periodo limitato.

examples.text: This week, I'm staying with my aunt.

sections.title: La struttura non si spezza
sections.body: Scegli am/is/are in base al soggetto, poi usa il verbo in -ing.

sections.title: Non dimenticare be
sections.body: Una forma in -ing senza am/is/are non forma il Present Continuous.

sections.title: Domande e negative cambiano be
sections.body: Per la domanda sposta am/is/are prima del soggetto. Per la negativa aggiungi not dopo be. Non usare do o does.

sections.title: Come formare -ing
sections.body: Di solito aggiungi -ing. Con molti verbi in -e togli la e; con alcuni verbi brevi raddoppi la consonante finale.

sections.title: Prima di continuare
points: Azione in corso o situazione temporanea.
Controlla lo spelling della forma in -ing.

questions.title: Che cosa descrive?
questions.prompt: Be quiet. Maya is talking to her tutor.
questions.instructions: Perché qui usiamo il Present Continuous?
questions.learning_objective: Recognise an action happening now.

options.text: La conversazione è in corso adesso.
È un'abitudine che si ripete ogni giorno.

feedback.explanation: Be quiet indica che Maya sta parlando proprio ora.

questions.title: Be + -ing
questions.prompt: Completa le frasi.
questions.learning_objective: Choose the correct auxiliary and -ing form.

content.text_template: I [[blank_1]] for the train and my friends [[blank_2]] near the entrance.

feedback.explanation: I → am waiting. My friends = they → are standing.

questions.title: Manca qualcosa
questions.prompt: Correggi: My friends playing basketball outside.
questions.learning_objective: Include the required be auxiliary in the present continuous.

accepted_answers: My friends are playing basketball outside.

feedback.explanation: My friends = they: serve are prima di playing.

questions.title: Costruisci la domanda
questions.prompt: Metti le parti nell'ordine corretto.
questions.learning_objective: Build a present continuous information question.

feedback.explanation: Why + are + you + wearing...? Non serve do.

questions.title: Spelling in -ing
questions.prompt: Completa con la forma in -ing corretta.
questions.learning_objective: Apply basic -ing spelling rules.

content.text_template: She is [[blank_1]] dinner while her brother is [[blank_2]] in the park.

feedback.explanation: Make perde la e → making. Run raddoppia la consonante finale → running.

exercises.title: Present Continuous — Allenati
exercises.description: Recupero attivo su uso, ausiliare, -ing, domande, negative, short answers e situazioni temporanee.
exercises.instructions: Decidi prima il significato, poi costruisci la forma completa.

sections.title: Usalo senza rileggere la regola
sections.instructions: Le attività cambiano formato e contesto per evitare risposte automatiche.

questions.title: Quali frasi sono corrette?
questions.prompt: Seleziona tutte le frasi corrette.
questions.instructions: Controlla sia be sia il verbo in -ing.
questions.learning_objective: Recognise correct present continuous affirmative, negative and question forms.

feedback.explanation: Serve be + -ing; nella negativa not viene dopo am/is/are.

questions.title: Che cosa sta succedendo?
questions.prompt: Completa la scena con il Present Continuous.
questions.instructions: Scrivi la forma completa del verbo.
questions.learning_objective: Produce present continuous forms in a connected scene.

content.text_template: It's lunch break. I [[blank_1]] at a table near the window. Two classmates [[blank_2]] about tomorrow's test, and our teacher [[blank_3]] coffee. We [[blank_4]] our phones because they are in our bags.

feedback.explanation: Ogni spazio richiede be + -ing; cambia solo la forma di be e, nella negativa, la posizione di not.

questions.title: Forma negativa
questions.prompt: Correggi: Luca is not wait for us outside.
questions.learning_objective: Use be + not + verb-ing in a present continuous negative.

accepted_answers: Luca is not waiting for us outside.
Luca isn't waiting for us outside.

feedback.explanation: Dopo is not serve waiting, non wait.

questions.title: Domanda con be
questions.prompt: Riordina la domanda.
questions.learning_objective: Build a present continuous information question.

feedback.explanation: What + is + your brother + doing...?

questions.title: Short answer
questions.prompt: Completa la risposta breve.
questions.instructions: Scegli la forma di be corretta.
questions.learning_objective: Use be correctly in a present continuous short answer.

content.text_template: Are the children sleeping? — No, they [[blank_1]].

feedback.explanation: La domanda usa are, quindi la risposta è No, they aren't.

questions.title: Controlla -ing
questions.prompt: Correggi: She is makeing a sandwich.
questions.learning_objective: Spell the -ing form of a verb ending in final -e.

feedback.explanation: Make perde la e prima di -ing: making.

questions.title: Produci la struttura completa
questions.prompt: Traduci: Stiamo studiando in biblioteca in questo momento.
questions.learning_objective: Produce a natural present continuous sentence for an action in progress.

accepted_answers: We are studying in the library right now.
We're studying in the library right now.
We are studying at the library right now.
We're studying at the library right now.

feedback.explanation: We richiede are; study diventa studying.

questions.title: Non solo questo secondo
questions.prompt: This month, I'm staying with my grandparents while my flat is being repaired.
questions.instructions: Perché staying è al Present Continuous?
questions.learning_objective: Recognise a temporary present situation.

options.text: È una situazione temporanea per un periodo limitato.
È una routine permanente che si ripete sempre.

feedback.explanation: This month indica un periodo temporaneo attuale, anche se l'azione non avviene in ogni singolo momento.

exercises.title: Present Continuous — Modalità scuola
exercises.description: Completamento, correzione, riordino, traduzione e scelta multipla in formati da verifica.
exercises.instructions: Lavora senza suggerimenti sulla regola. Il feedback arriva alla fine.

sections.title: Formati da verifica
sections.instructions: Scegli autonomamente la struttura corretta dal contesto.

questions.title: Complete the text
questions.prompt: Complete the text with the Present Continuous form of the verbs in context.
questions.instructions: Write the complete verb form in each gap.
questions.learning_objective: Complete a connected school-style text with present continuous forms.

content.text_template: It's break time. Sara [[blank_1]] to her friend near the door. Two students [[blank_2]] a poster, and I [[blank_3]] my notes for the next lesson. Our teacher [[blank_4]] in the classroom because she has a meeting.

feedback.explanation: Ogni azione è in corso nella scena: controlla soggetto, be e spelling della forma in -ing.

questions.title: Correct the sentence
questions.prompt: Correct: We waiting for the teacher outside.
questions.learning_objective: Correct a missing present continuous auxiliary.

accepted_answers: We are waiting for the teacher outside.
We're waiting for the teacher outside.

feedback.explanation: We richiede are prima di waiting.

questions.title: Correct the question
questions.prompt: Correct: Do you studying for the test?
questions.learning_objective: Form a present continuous yes/no question with be rather than do.

accepted_answers: Are you studying for the test?

feedback.explanation: Nel Present Continuous la domanda usa be: Are you studying...?

questions.title: Put the words in order
questions.prompt: Put the words in the correct order.
questions.learning_objective: Build a present continuous information question.

feedback.explanation: Where + are + the children + playing?

questions.title: Translate
questions.prompt: Traduci: Perché stai correndo? Ti sto aspettando alla fermata.
questions.learning_objective: Translate a present continuous question and statement accurately.

accepted_answers: Why are you running? I'm waiting for you at the bus stop.
Why are you running? I am waiting for you at the bus stop.
Why are you running? I'm waiting for you at the stop.
Why are you running? I am waiting for you at the stop.

feedback.explanation: Why are you running? usa be prima del soggetto; I am waiting usa am + -ing.

questions.title: Choose the correct sentence
questions.prompt: Which sentence is correct?
questions.learning_objective: Recognise a complete present continuous negative.

options.text: The students aren't using their phones.
The students don't using their phones.
The students aren't use their phones.

feedback.explanation: La negativa è aren't + using.

exercises.title: Present Continuous — Mini-verifica
exercises.description: Controllo breve su uso, struttura, domande, negative e spelling senza spiegazione preventiva.
exercises.instructions: Rispondi senza consultare la spiegazione. Il feedback arriva alla fine.

sections.title: Mini-verifica
sections.instructions: Le domande coprono tutti i punti essenziali del topic.

questions.title: Use
questions.prompt: Look! The dog ___ into the garden.
questions.learning_objective: Choose the present continuous for an action happening now.

feedback.explanation: Look! segnala un'azione in corso: is running.

questions.title: Auxiliary
questions.prompt: Complete the sentence.
questions.learning_objective: Choose the correct be auxiliary in a present continuous statement.

content.text_template: My parents [[blank_1]] dinner in the kitchen.

feedback.explanation: My parents = they → are making.

questions.title: -ing spelling
questions.prompt: Complete the sentence.
questions.learning_objective: Apply -ing spelling after a final -e verb.

content.text_template: I am [[blank_1]] an email to my teacher.

feedback.explanation: Write perde la e: writing.

questions.title: Negative
questions.prompt: Correct: She not is wearing her glasses today.
questions.learning_objective: Place not correctly in a present continuous negative.

accepted_answers: She is not wearing her glasses today.
She isn't wearing her glasses today.

feedback.explanation: Not viene dopo is: She is not wearing...

questions.title: Question
questions.prompt: Put the words in order.
questions.learning_objective: Build a present continuous yes/no question.

feedback.explanation: Is + your sister + coming...?

questions.title: Short answer
questions.prompt: Is Marco working today?
questions.learning_objective: Use the correct auxiliary in a present continuous short answer.

feedback.explanation: La domanda usa is, quindi la risposta riprende is.

questions.title: Temporary situation
questions.prompt: For a few weeks, we're using a different classroom because ours is being painted.
questions.instructions: Why is we're using appropriate here?
questions.learning_objective: Recognise a temporary present situation.

options.text: The situation finished in the past.
It is their permanent normal classroom.

feedback.explanation: For a few weeks signals a temporary situation around the present.

questions.title: Final production
questions.prompt: Traduci: I ragazzi stanno aspettando fuori e io sto cercando le chiavi.
questions.learning_objective: Produce two coordinated present continuous clauses with different subjects.

accepted_answers: The boys are waiting outside and I am looking for the keys.
The boys are waiting outside and I'm looking for the keys.
The kids are waiting outside and I am looking for the keys.
The kids are waiting outside and I'm looking for the keys.

feedback.explanation: The boys/kids → are waiting; I → am looking.
